dedupe_keys.name: global flood database processing and validation software

description: Cloud to Street's Global Flood Database repository publishes the processing and analysis workflow behind the satellite flood database. It includes Python Earth Engine flood mapping, JavaScript validation and population-exposure routines, and R summary and uncertainty analyses. Inputs are Dartmouth flood-event polygons, MODIS and validation imagery, and population surfaces; outputs are flood maps, validation metrics and exposure summaries. The documented analyses concern historical flood events and population change between 2000 and 2015, with geographic coverage inherited from the selected events. Code is free under MIT; source datasets and Earth Engine access have separate terms. A limitation is that cloud-obscured imagery and population assumptions affect results, and scripts use different isolated-pixel filtering choices. The workflow can reproduce or adapt hazard-exposure analysis for infrastructure simulations. The existing Global Flood Database record (data-global-flood-database) covers the mapped product, but does not explicitly cover this software. No raster or validation dataset was downloaded.
